categories.main_business_segments: Nanfang Ventilator Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of ventilation and air handling systems. Its main business segments include HVAC equipment for nuclear power plants, metro systems, tunnels, large industrial facilities, and civil buildings. The company also operates a subsidiary focused on heavy metal 3D printing technology and additive manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as heavy metal 3D printing and additive manufacturing, particularly developed by its subsidiary Nanfang Additive Technology. It employs integrated design and manufacturing methods for ventilation and air handling systems, including nuclear-grade HVAC equipment. The company has established a comprehensive R&D and testing laboratory accredited nationally, supporting product innovation and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large state-owned enterprises in nuclear power, metro, tunnel, industrial, and civil construction sectors. Major clients include China General Nuclear Power Group, China National Nuclear Corporation, and various city metro companies. The company serves domestic infrastructure projects and is expanding into international markets such as Pakistan and Indonesia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and production base in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It is expanding its overseas presence through international projects in countries like Pakistan and Indonesia, focusing on nuclear power and industrial ventilation markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanfang Ventilator operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and system integrator of ventilation and air handling equipment. It designs, produces, and sells core HVAC components and systems directly to end customers in infrastructure and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D, focusing on developing new products such as safety-grade pneumatic isolation valves, high-temperature centrifugal fans, and modular heavy-duty air conditioning units. It emphasizes digital transformation, lean management, and expanding 3D printing services to create new growth drivers. Strategic plans include enhancing domestic market leadership and steadily growing international business.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ventilation and air handling system equipment. The company also earns income from installation services, leasing of facilities, and investment returns. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to large infrastructure and industrial clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanfang Ventilator is one of the largest specialized ventilation and air handling system manufacturers in South China, holding a leading domestic market position in nuclear power HVAC equipment and metro/tunnel ventilation systems. It competes with a limited number of domestic and international manufacturers in high-end HVAC equipment for critical infrastructure sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 620 million, a 35.27% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.5 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. The company has shown strong growth momentum driven by increased order execution in nuclear power and metro projects. Total assets reached about RMB 2.08 billion, reflecting steady expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanfang Ventilator emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, high product quality, and compliance with stringent nuclear safety standards. It offers domestically produced, high-reliability HVAC equipment that breaks foreign technology monopolies, ensuring safety and performance in critical infrastructure. The company’s integrated system solutions, extensive project experience, and recognized certifications provide competitive advantages and trusted customer relationships.
